Spacious 4-Bedroom Family Home in a Quiet Montevideo Setting

Web Ref. RL72396
Land size 414.00 m²
Monthly Bond Repayment
R17,970.83
Welcome to this spacious and well-appointed 4-bedroom family home in the peaceful area of Montevideo.

The home offers four bedrooms, with three featuring built-in cupboards, while the generously sized main bedroom boasts its own en-suite bathroom. There are also an additional 1.5 bathrooms, making this home well suited for a growing family.

The property offers a comfortable lounge with a fireplace, a separate dining room and a welcoming entrance hall that can also be used as an additional sitting area.

For those who enjoy entertaining, the back of the property features a built-in braai area, creating a great space for family gatherings and relaxed weekends.

There is secure undercover parking for up to four vehicles, with access through a remote-controlled gate. The property also offers a spacious front yard, providing additional outdoor space for the family.

Situated in a quiet and peaceful area, this home offers space, comfort and security, making it an ideal choice for a family looking for a place to call home.

Contact me today to arrange a viewing.

Offer Rules
You will be notified of other offers via email.

All sales are non-suspensive and sold as is "voetstoots". Properties on sale with a "Offers From" price will be sold subject to confirmation of the seller. No "Offer" will be allowed to be made "ON BEHALF" unless the proxy giving a 3rd party permission is uploaded as required. No buyer can withdraw a "Offer" at any stage. The successful buyer must pay his deposit in the relevant trust accounts within 2 working days of his offer being accepted by means of EFT. No other payment method will be accepted. Outstanding balance of offer price to be delivered by means of guarantee, mortgage finance or cash. Should any dispute arise between two or more buyers, the property may be re-sold or Harcourts South Africa will declare who is the successful bidder. Should Harcourts South Africa commit any error in conducting the sale, such mistake shall not be considered binding either upon the seller or the purchaser but shall be rectified. Harcourts South Africa shall have the right re-sell any given property if the successful buyer does not pay his deposit in the allotted time. The successful buyer cannot occupy the property prior to registration without special arrangement from the seller. Harcourts South Africa shall have the right to withdraw any property prior to the offer ending for any reason whatsoever at their discretion.
